data.text/markdown:
What just happened

Cell Defines Reruns when
data tracks never (it is the source)
controls genre_pick, year_range, min_energy tracks changes
filter filtered any control moves
chart chart filtered changes
selection sel you select on the chart
marimo reads the variables each cell defines and references, builds a DAG, and reruns descendants in order. There is no "Run All", and no stale state — deleting a cell also deletes its variables. One rule to internalise: a UI element's .value must be read in a different cell than the one that creates it. Same cell = no reactivity.
